text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa named Alejandro Burillo Azcarraga as vice-president of the board and personal adviser to the chairman Emilio Azcarraga Jean.

Burillo Azcarraga, a cousin of the chairman of the Spanish-speaking world's largest media organisation, will also become the company's international affairs president. In addition, he will chair the committee that manages Televisa's soccer business.
Currently a shareholding board member, Burillo Azcarraga will also be the chairman of the executive committee of Grupo Televicentro, a unit of Televisa.
Televisa, announcing the new moves on the company's news programs Monday night, said the posts will be ratified at the firm's June 23 board meeting.
